cardOverview.overviewText: A PVR Platinum variant providing higher free movie tickets, premium dining privileges, and milestone vouchers for avid entertainment lovers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Kotak Mahindra Bank Customer Care at 1860 266 2666 or email care@zurichkotak.com within 30 days of the incident. Ensure to submit all required documents within 60 days of reporting the claim.
